prompt: Production modeling reference sheet for a grounded realistic WW2 real-time strategy game. Neutral light gray studio background, orthographic views without perspective distortion, restrained matte materials and clear silhouettes. Exactly three rows and five columns with small headings FRONT, LEFT, BACK, RIGHT, TOP. Row one: one US WW2 infantry soldier, plausible adult proportions, M1 helmet, fitted olive drab uniform, compact web belt and pouches snug on body, modest backpack and WWII rifle held close. Row two: M4 Sherman tank with recognizable five bogie-style track assemblies only if appropriate, coherent historically plausible hull and turret, long main gun and modest details. Row three: BA-64 small four wheeled armored scout car with angular hull and small open turret. Each row shows exactly the same object from front, left side, back, right side, and top. Within each row use identical scale in all five cells. Keep every object and projecting part fully visible. Realistic useful construction and proportions, not a toy or caricature, no oversized equipment. Clean grids with ample spacing. This is visual design reference rather than a historical blueprint.
